content: flutter_secure_storage 11.0.0 (2026-08-06), 160/160 points, 3.75M downloads/30d, repo juliansteenbakker/flutter_secure_storage. Linux impl is flutter_secure_storage_linux 3.0.2 (2026-08-06), a C++ plugin over libsecret (Secret.hpp) reaching the Secret Service via D-Bus. Requires libsecret-1-dev at build and a running Secret Service daemon (gnome-keyring / kwalletd) at runtime. v11 removed all v10 deprecations (Android-only impact). v11 Linux fixes: handle missing default keyring, fail closed on orphaned keyring data. Locked/unavailable keyring surfaces as a catchable PlatformException with code KeyringLocked. Headless CI needs eval $(dbus-launch --sh-syntax) plus gnome-keyring-daemon --unlock --daemonize --components=secrets.
